Appearance

Pale woman with long black hair that seems to absorb light. Dark elegant robes trimmed with silver, piercing eyes.

What We Know

Professor of Necromancy at the Highreach Wizard's Tower. Despite her unsettling specialty, she is compassionate and teaches students to respect the boundary between life and death.

First Impressions

Quiet and intense — her gaze feels like it's looking through you, not at you.
